note: USACE campground on the site of Old Greenville at the head of Wappapello Lake, beside the St. Francis River. The west-row sites (7, 9, 10 and 59-67) back onto a wooded riverbank 30-50 m from the water. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 94 overnight sites (86 single + 8 double) all 50A/water/sewer, $28 ($48 doubles), Apr 1 - Nov 1, 2-night weekend minimum. Riverfront should go to riverview at best: the west-row pads are 32-51 m from the river across mown grass and a continuous wooded bank. Phone 573-224-3884 to add. PIN is the facility point by the entrance/day use ~400 m SE of the loops: move to 37.1036,-90.4578.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (riverfront -> riverview): the catalog has no Proximity to Water attribute. Sites between the loop road and the St. Francis River (river ~80-90 m wide, so riverfront-class): 59/60 (~51 m to the water), 61 (~36 m), 62 (~38 m), 65 (~40 m), 66 (~45 m), 67, 7 (~32 m), 9 (~34 m), 10 (~35 m). Between each pad and the water is mown lawn and then a continuous wooded bank strip ~15-25 m deep down to a riprapped edge. The rec.gov site photos (2019-05-28, leaf-on) for sites 7, 9, 61 and 62 show only a solid treeline behind the pads, no water. A continuous treeline is a buffer, so no site earns riverfront; leaf-off imagery shows the river through the bare bank trees 30-50 m away, so riverview is the most it holds (if a view in the official photos is required, it is not waterfront). Site 4 and the rest of the south loop have the loop road between them and the river.

PHONE (to add): rec.gov facility_phone 573-224-3884 ('Between 04/01/2026 and 11/02/2026 this location is staffed. Please call (573) 224-3884'); off-season (573) 778-5404 for general information (Wappapello Lake office). None stored.
PIN: stored 37.1004,-90.4558 = the RIDB facility point, at the entrance road by the day-use/group-shelter area ~400 m SE of the sites' centre. Move onto the loops: 37.1036,-90.4578.

SEASON / FCFS: the stored note's 'reservable in peak season, FCFS off-peak' has no source: the calendar shows every site Closed 2026-11-02 and Not Available 2026-11-03 through March, and the office is unstaffed then. Season written 04-01 to 11-01 from the calendar and the staffed dates; fcfs not written.
SITE COUNT: the description says 106 campsites; the catalog has 94 bookable overnight units (86 single, 8 double = 102 site numbers). Count written as 94 with the doubles named in sites.note.
